hooks.command: d="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || printf %s "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR")"; py="$(command -v python3 || command -v python)"; if [ -z "$d" ] || [ -z "$py" ]; then echo "FEOS: repository root or Python not found; blocking edit (fail closed)." >&2; exit 2; fi; "$py" "$d/scripts/feos_hook_protect.py" || exit 2
